verdict.rationale: Shared or team inboxes are a fair axis for an email product like Outlook, but the evidence pack never documents shared mailboxes or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state. The only nearby item is delegated send-on-behalf, which lets one user send as another. That is a related but different feature and does not show a team sharing one inbox's state, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
